Please refer the following links for the channel specific Data Streams formats:

- [SMS](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference/data-streams-sms)
- [RCS](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference/data-streams-rcs)
- [Email](https://developers.webexconnect.io/reference/data-streams-email) 
- [In-App](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference/data-streams-in-app)
- [Apple Messages for Business](https://developers.imiconnect.io/reference/data-streams-apple-messages-for-business)
- [Audit Logs](https://developers.webexconnect.io/reference/data-streams-audit-logs)

## API reference metadata

These are source metadata and examples. `api.auth` is ReadMe metadata; verify authentication in the documented headers/security scheme.

```json
{
  "method": "get",
  "url": "",
  "auth": "required",
  "results": {
    "codes": [
      {
        "name": "",
        "code": "{}",
        "language": "json",
        "status": 200
      },
      {
        "name": "",
        "code": "{}",
        "language": "json",
        "status": 400
      }
    ]
  },
  "params": [],
  "examples": {
    "codes": []
  }
}
```
